text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Kikuka Sho—the final race of the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: We're finally here at the biggest event of the autumn season.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Did you know there are superstitions about each of the three Classic races?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: The fastest Umamusume excels in the Satsuki Sho, the luckiest excels in the Derby…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: And in the Kikuka Sho… it's the strongest.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I've come here to show my strength—that's my plan! ♪
choice_data_list: When it comes to power, you're number one!
When it comes to power, you're number one!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I think your idea of strength might be a little different from mine.
choice_data_list: You're not talking about your physical abilities?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: No, the strength I'm talking about is…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: We didn't choose each other based on talent or other measures.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: We were true to our feelings… and chose the person we wanted most by our side.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: That's why we were both able to get back on our feet so magnificently after going through the hardships we did.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: We have an irreplaceable bond… And that's why…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm going to show it to everyone! ♪
choice_data_list: You can do it, Super Creek!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I will! Wait for me with open arms at the finish line, my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Something inside her has burst open. I'm sure this unrestrained Super Creek will get the job done!
